view.scene_description: A modern bookstore or library interior with wooden bookshelves filled with books. A person in a white jacket sits at a desk near a window, working on a laptop. The space features warm lighting, decorative circular lights, and a curved wooden platform. Large windows let in natural light, and green plants add a touch of nature.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a white hooded jacket and glasses is seated at a desk, focused on a laptop. They are positioned near a large window on the left side of the frame. Their posture suggests concentration. A brown bag rests beside their chair.

objects.label: laptop
objects.observation: An open laptop is on the desk in front of the person. Its screen is visible but indistinct. The laptop is placed directly on the desk surface, supported by the desk’s flat top. It is partially obscured by the person’s arm.

objects.label: bookshelf
objects.observation: Large wooden bookshelves line the walls, filled with numerous books arranged neatly. The shelves extend from floor to ceiling and are illuminated from within. One section has an arched doorway leading to another area. Books vary in size and color.

objects.label: window
objects.observation: A large window occupies the left side of the frame, allowing bright natural light to enter. Trees and sky are visible outside. The window is framed by a dark vertical beam. It is partially obscured by the person and a potted plant.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: A tall green leafy plant stands between the person and the bookshelf. Its leaves are broad and vibrant. The plant is in a dark pot, resting on the floor near the desk. It partially blocks the view of the person’s legs.

objects.label: desk
objects.observation: A wooden desk is situated in the foreground, supporting the laptop and other items. It has a smooth surface and is positioned under the window. The desk is partially obscured by the person and the plant.

objects.label: chair
objects.observation: A black chair is positioned under the desk where the person is sitting. Only the backrest and part of the seat are visible. The chair is made of metal and fabric, and it is in direct contact with the floor.

objects.label: bag
objects.observation: A brown leather-like bag is hanging on the chair’s armrest. It has handles and appears to be a tote bag. The bag is partially obscured by the chair and the person’s body.

objects.label: ceiling light
objects.observation: Circular recessed lights are embedded in the ceiling above the bookshelves. They emit a warm glow. The ceiling is dark and contrasts with the brightly lit shelves below.

objects.label: curved platform
objects.observation: A wooden curved platform extends from the bookshelf area toward the right side of the room. It has a glowing edge and appears to be a stage or seating area. It is partially obscured by the bookshelf and the person.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000012", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
